issue.detail: Spec does not define initial q value or behavior at time 0; contract has no reset and first_released_cycle 0ns, but S04 shows q=x at 0ns. Alternative: q initializes to 0 at time 0 regardless of a, then increments on posedge when a=0. Distinguishing sequence: first row a=1 at posedge would yield q=0 under alternative vs q=x under contract (no reset).
issue.alternative: q initializes to 0 at time 0, then increments on posedge when a=0, holds when a=1.
